name: Exam Skills
notes: Exam technique across every subject, practised in the Wednesday timed paper. Never grade-converted: the marks of each sitting land on the real subjects as check attempts; this subject holds what the sitting showed about technique.

topics.name: Reading time: skim the whole paper before starting
Moving on from a stuck question (flag and return)
Command words and what each demands
Mark allocation sets the length of the answer
Multi-part questions: using an earlier part
One-mark answers: the answer and nothing else
Method marks: a route the scheme can credit
Extended answers: hitting the level descriptors
Never blank: a sensible attempt on every question

_note: The tracker_create_subject payload for the Exam Skills subject. Every topic starts notstarted; statuses move only through sessions logged from her exam-practice project after each sitting. Re-running it adds topics without touching statuses.
